Payments: electronic payment from the American Express online account (no charge, including AutoPay), Pay by Phone at 1-844-273-1384, or check by mail per the loan invoice. help.title: Paying your Personal Loan
paragraphs: Your Personal Loan is repaid in fixed monthly installments. Log in to your American Express online account, choose the loan account and make an electronic payment from your bank account. There is no charge for payments made from your online account, including AutoPay.

You can also pay by phone through Customer Care at 1-844-273-1384, or mail a check by following the instructions on your loan invoice. Mailed checks take longer to arrive, so paying online each month or using AutoPay helps you stay on time.

You may pay extra or pay the loan off early with no prepayment penalty. To pay it off, pay the Outstanding Personal Loan Balance shown online or on your invoice before the Next Invoice Date, or additional interest may post.

help.title: AutoPay for Personal Loans
paragraphs: Turn on AutoPay in your American Express online account under Payments. Each invoice period American Express debits the Monthly Payment Due, including any fees, from the bank account you choose; your loan invoice shows the amount and the debit date.

The debit date is at least 15 days after your invoice date. You can move it online to any day from 15 to 25 days after the invoice date. If it falls on a weekend or bank holiday, the debit runs the next business day and is not treated as late.

To stop AutoPay, turn it off online, call 1-844-273-1384 or write to American Express, P.O. Box 981540, El Paso, TX 79998. Your request must arrive at least 2 business days before the scheduled debit date. You can still make extra payments while enrolled.

help.title: Personal Loan fees and due date
paragraphs: There are no application or origination fees and no prepayment penalty. A $39 fee applies in any month your payment arrives after the due date on your invoice, or when a payment is returned for insufficient funds; late payments may also be reported to credit bureaus.
Your payment due date is set when the loan is approved and stays the same day each month for the whole repayment period. It cannot be changed.

help.title: Contact American Express about your Personal Loan
paragraphs: Chat with us after logging in to your American Express online account, or call 1-844-273-1384, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. ET.
